scientific_integrity: Finite exhaustive identification, graph construction and independent all-pairs BFS in self-contained Python 3 and C++17. All claimed new assertions refer solely to adjacent-vertex token slides, not to earlier known optimum-code counts and unrestricted token-jump graph. No independent scholarly audit.
scientific_limitations: Exact result concerns the fixed sixteen-vertex rook graph, not every strongly regular graph or arbitrary rook sizes.
A previous complete classification already provides the minimum code count and unrestricted jump graph; those facts are not novel.
Potential unindexed prior results remain a historical-priority risk.
title: Sharp six-slide mobility of minimum identifying codes in the four-by-four rook graph
